referenceSourceReview.verificationBoundary: These are user-provided research summaries. Their internal chapter-title and evidence labels have not been independently checked against novel text and are not promoted here to verified canon.
referenceSourceReview.aSourceAuditId: game-project/docs/r6-world-life-feedback-content.md#增量来源审计：经济、出行与技艺
referenceSourceReview.aSourceAuditDisposition: A's source labels remain secondary-source claims, not independently verified quotations. Per the user's latest direction, this limitation is traceability metadata, not a design veto: useful economic strata, craft logic, travel progression, and cited setting terms may enter a provisional editable game framework.
referenceSourceReview.projectRulePrecedence: Existing user-approved project rule allowing reincarnation points to preserve an already attained realm takes precedence over any contrary secondary-summary suggestion.
adopted: Separate current-life mortal cash, cultivator currency/resources, and cross-life reincarnation points into distinct ledgers. Cultivator goods remain item inventory; upper-tier markets may denominate registered purchases in spirit stones, never silently merge those balances with mortal cash.
Keep wish-power distinct from money: model it as a possible strategic obligation/resource with cause-linked gain and backlash, not a vendor tender or cash conversion.

Adopt a connected progression model: household/work/food and land travel -> local craft apprenticeship/public furnace and markets -> cultivator material and spirit-stone markets -> higher crafts and production -> long-distance steam/extraordinary travel. These are editable setting tiers; the current R6 slice implements only the specified local routes/economy/conditions.

Use skills, tools, materials, recipes, site permission, time, and consequences as interlocking gates. Preserve R4 registered alchemy logic in the current slice; future tools/lineages extend it rather than silently changing it.
gameplayInventions: Use a coherent cash hierarchy 文/钱/两银; 1钱=100文, 1两银=10钱=1,000文. Old wealth converts at 1 legacy unit=100文=1钱. These are provisional game denominations because the reference does not identify source currency units.

Adopt 1 lower-grade spirit stone = 100 taels as a provisional game conversion convention from the reference's explicit completion suggestion; set medium and upper grades at 100 of the preceding grade for exact ledger display. This is adjustable game balance, not verified canon, and no exchange action is enabled in this slice.

Walking, paid carriage service, ration price, haggling spread, craft progression, and future travel tiers are authored game rules. Current R6 implementation proposals remain WARN until runtime and playtest evidence exist.
adoptedSettingFrameworkNotCurrentImpleme: Mortal transport may progress from foot/horse/cart/boat to steamship and extraordinary/star routes; route IDs, time, supply, fares, closures, and cause-linked encounters must be registered per era. No current map edge is invented for these tiers.

Include candidate setting names and craft lines from the references as editable world material: 紫符/金符; 灵器/半步道器/道器/上品道器; 阵法、机关/傀儡、神通与百家传承; 太荒古炉、炼妖炉、彼岸号; low-tier production can scale, high-tier artifacts depend on registered rare causes.

A future medicine framework can relate healing, breakthrough, enhancement, and longevity products to 黄/玄/地/天 grades. Failure may lead to a registered dangerous result such as 妖丹 only as a designed causal branch; neither grades nor failure products are current R4 facts or current R6 outputs.

Reference suggestion that reincarnation points cannot preserve realms is adapted to the confirmed project rule: points may preserve only a realm the player has actually attained; they do not purchase an unearned realm or pay for current-life goods.

Wish-power/public sentiment is a non-cash strategic liability/resource candidate: cause-linked use may create backlash; no conversion rate or purchase behavior is defined until a real registered Qingxu source exists.
currentSliceDeferrals: No ship, steamship, interworld, or star route is added to the current five-location R6 route graph; these remain present in the editable progression framework for later implementation.
No profession tree, new R4 alchemy grades, or guaranteed monster-dan failure item is added to the current runtime contract; future nodes require stable IDs, costs, causes, and acceptance evidence.

resolution.conversion: One integer tick is one quarter-hour (一刻); one traditional double-hour 时辰 is eight ticks; one day is 96 ticks. Durations add exactly as integers; no per-action rounding. The displayed shichen follows traditional civil-clock spans: 子时 23:00-00:59; 丑时 01:00-02:59; 寅时 03:00-04:59; 卯时 05:00-06:59; 辰时 07:00-08:59; 巳时 09:00-10:59; 午时 11:00-12:59; 未时 13:00-14:59; 申时 15:00-16:59; 酉时 17:00-18:59; 戌时 19:00-20:59; 亥时 21:00-22:59. Civil worldDay still changes at 00:00; 子时 spans that date boundary.

bounds.integerRule: Accept only finite, nonnegative, safe integers. Reject negative, fractional, NaN, Infinity, unsafe or out-of-bound world ticks/durations before any cost, receipt, queue, location, or clock mutation. Reject an addition whose result exceeds maximumWorldTickInclusive; never wrap or clamp.

calendarProjection.worldDay: floor(worldTick/96), derived read-only; day zero is 1000-01-01
calendarProjection.shichenIndex: floor(((tickWithinDay+4) mod 96)/8), indexed 子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥; civil date still changes at tickWithinDay=0.
calendarProjection.keIndex: ((tickWithinDay+4) mod 8)+1; ordinal ke within the displayed shichen, counted from its civil-clock start.
calendarProjection.storageRule: Only runtimeState.worldTick is writable and authoritative. runtimeState.worldDay and all date/time/age/expiry/remaining projections are derived read-only compatibility fields; no parallel world.r6WorldTime clock may be written.
calendarProjection.noDailyRoutineRule: Time passing alone does not impose sleep, meal, work, night-travel, stamina, or day/night availability costs. Existing registered health, food, death, and event rules remain unchanged.
calendarProjection.keRule: One ke is 15 minutes. Count from the start of the displayed shichen across civil midnight: 23:00 子初刻1; 00:00 子第5刻; 00:45 子第8刻; 01:00 丑初刻1.

scheduler.sameTickRule: At a day boundary, run dayBoundaryOrder once before completing an action due on that exact tick. At a non-day action completion tick, run middayCompletionOrder. Persist phase receipts/cursor keyed by worldId+boundaryTick so save/reload cannot replay a phase. A started action keeps its reserved inputs and idempotency key; effects commit only under its registered completion/abort policy. A lifeLimitWorldTick is also an exact scheduler boundary, including intraday ticks; run death_check before any action completion or effect at that tick, and do not process later phases for the dead life.
scheduler.advanceRule: Advance to the next of action completion, day boundary, active expiry, blocking cause, or requested target tick. At a day boundary, weather/stock/seat/lease/offer nodes resolve before action completion; then resume remaining action ticks. A day is never skipped by a long action. Include the exact lifeLimitWorldTick as a boundary; if earlier than the next day/action boundary, advance there and resolve death before any same-tick effects.
scheduler.dayNodeOnceRule: Each derived worldDay runs world_nodes exactly once. Intraday actions do not repeat daily events, restocks, seat resets, offer publication, or weather facts.

perLifeClock.lifespanSource: R4 progressionRules.lifespanYearsByRealm; lifespanTicks=floor(realmLifeYears*360*96*bodyLifeFactorBasisPoints/10000), using integer arithmetic and applying bodyLifeFactorBasisPoints once; do not round to a whole day.
perLifeClock.deathBoundary: lifeLimitWorldTick=lifeStartWorldTick+floor(realmLifeYears*360*96*bodyLifeFactorBasisPoints/10000), using integer ticks without rounding lifespan to whole days. Treat this exact tick as a scheduler boundary even intraday; death_check precedes world_nodes/action_completion at a coincident midnight, and precedes action_completion/causal followups at an intraday tick. No action effect may commit at or after the life limit.
perLifeClock.rebirth: Keep worldTick continuous. On a valid rebirth, set lifeStartWorldTick=worldTick and derive new life age 0; preserve existing reincarnation-point spending and attained-realm retention rules unchanged.

longActionRules.daysToTicks: Any preserved R4 full-day action converts exactly days*96 ticks once at dispatch; never apply both legacy days and durationTicks to one action.
longActionRules.travel: Carriage/walking route progress consumes remaining route ticks only while route is open. WorldTick continues during choice/action pauses; route progress freezes during a 30-day practice, 3-day alchemy, closure, or event decision. Resume the same transaction and charge once.
longActionRules.closure: Flood [D,D+3) means [D*96,(D+3)*96); weather is generated once at each worldDay boundary from derived worldDay and persisted seed. The cause is checked before travel progress. D+3 00:00 expires it before route movement resumes.
longActionRules.courier: 75-day runner duty=7200 ticks; offer window is [cycleStartTick,cycleStartTick+30*96). The same-day physical midpoint intersection rule still applies. Existing dueWorldDay inclusive deadlines project to exclusive deadline tick=(dueWorldDay+1)*96; exact-tick deadline semantics are half-open.
longActionRules.lease: R6 portable furnace lease lasts exactly 30*96=2880 ticks from issuedAtTick; usable when currentTick<expiresAtTick. A 288-tick alchemy may start only when currentTick+288<=expiresAtTick. Equality reserves completion before expiry is applied to later use; one tick short rejects before charge/material/time mutation.
longActionRules.market: Quote issue time is exact. A quote with legacy quoteExpiryWorldDays=0 remains valid only until the exclusive start of the next derived worldDay. A counter/sign must complete before expiry; otherwise reject with no trade settlement. One counter attempt per character/item/side/worldDay remains. Receipt is created at atomic settlement; result acknowledgement costs zero. The old same-day quote validity maps to next civil midnight exclusive. Its issue/completion points are distinct from package inclusive due dates.
longActionRules.dailySources: Market stock, carriage seat counts, ration supplier caps, 30-day replenishments, courier cycle publication, and weather facts reset/resolve only in world_nodes at a derived day boundary; one boundary receipt prevents duplicates.
longActionRules.endOfDay: Inclusive package/courier due dates remain valid through the last tick before the following civil date boundary, then expire at (dueDay+1)*96. Lease expiry follows its owning lease rule; public-furnace permit follows furnacePermit and is not covered by a generic inclusive-lease statement.
longActionRules.marketTransactionTime: The registered one-step buy/sell action of 2 ticks is an alternative bundled flow equal to quote issue (1) + signature/settlement (1); it replaces those two steps and must not be added to them. In the explicit multi-step flow, issue=1, optional counter=1, sign=1; thus no-counter total=2 and one-counter total=3. Read/inspect/decline of an uncommitted quote is zero ticks; sign action begins at submission and completes after its stated tick duration. Settlement is permitted only if its completion tick is strictly before the quote expiry exclusive tick.
longActionRules.decisionTiming: For the courier, accept and decline each consume 4 ticks (explicit exception to generic free decline). The choice starts when submitted and commits at completionTick=startTick+4. Offer acceptance is valid only when completionTick<offerWindowEndAtTickExclusive; a delivery is valid only when its signed settlement completionTick<dueAtTickExclusive. At an exact exclusive end tick, reject before state/resource mutation. Other no-labor declines remain zero ticks.
longActionRules.furnacePermit: Legacy public-furnace permit is a separate record. Its old v2 check expired only when worldDay>issuedDay+validDays, so the terminal civil date remains available. Migrate its exclusive expiry to (issuedDay+validDays+1)*96. A three-day action still requires currentTick+288<=expiresAtTick; equality succeeds, one tick short rejects without mutation.

migration.idempotency: If schemaVersion>=3 and this receipt exists, no-op. Stage a complete snapshot and validate all fields before atomic commit; on any invalid/missing required source, preserve the original save byte-for-byte and report a blocking reason. The receipt key is worldId+characterId+lifeIndex+sourceSchemaVersion.
migration.legacyWorldDaySource: Actual v2 source is runtimeState.worldDay. The single v3 authoritative path is runtimeState.worldTick. If that exact tick is absent, convert runtimeState.worldDay*96 at civil 00:00. If the exact tick already exists, preserve it and validate any coexisting day projection; missing unrelated fields do not block migration.
migration.ageSource: Actual v2 character fields are character.birthDay and derived character.ageDays=(runtimeState.worldDay-character.birthDay), confirmed at code/private-deploy/candidate-site/r6-demo/engine/r4-world-engine.js:2296. Prefer birthDay when present and derive lifeStartWorldTick=birthDay*96. If only ageDays exists, derive from runtimeState.worldTick-ageDays*96. If only an exact lifeStartWorldTick exists, preserve it. If no anchor exists, preserve character/world data and record a migration warning rather than block the whole legacy save or guess a new age.
migration.inFlight: Actual v2 path is inFlightTransaction.startedDay/targetDay (code/private-deploy/candidate-site/r6-demo/engine/r4-world-engine.js:2433). These are action start/completion points, each mapping to D*96; targetDay is not an inclusive deadline. Preserve actual progress fields and names; convert only fields verified as day counts, while opaque/unrecognized fields remain unchanged. If the transaction is absent, skip it. If timing keys are missing, preserve that object unchanged and add a migration warning that prevents that transaction alone from replay/settlement until reconciliation; continue unrelated world/character migration. Package/courier inclusive deadlines use separate owner paths and map to (D+1)*96.
migration.pendingReceipts: Preserve the exact pending receipt/event/outcome ID, readState, created time, idempotency key and queued position. A pending confirmation is not re-enqueued or auto-confirmed and requires 0 ticks. Existing receipt IDs stay immutable.

legacyDayFields.runtimeState.worldDay: Actual legacy source path -> runtimeState.worldTick=runtimeState.worldDay*96 at 00:00. Preserve worldDay only as a derived compatibility projection.
legacyDayFields.character.birthDay: Actual legacy source path -> character.lifeStartWorldTick=character.birthDay*96 when present.
legacyDayFields.character.ageDays: Actual v2 value/projection at r4-world-engine.js:2296 is worldDay-birthDay. Prefer character.birthDay as its anchor and rederive ageDays from migrated worldTick; when birthDay is absent but ageDays exists, use ageDays to derive lifeStartWorldTick. If both disagree, birthDay remains the source and a reconciliation warning is retained; do not block unrelated save migration.
legacyDayFields.inFlightTransaction.targetDay: Actual legacy source path -> inFlightTransaction.targetAtTick=targetDay*96; targetDay here is the action completion point, not an inclusive package deadline. Example startedDay=5842,targetDay=5845 => startAtTick=5842*96,targetAtTick=5845*96,durationTicks=3*96.
legacyDayFields.inFlightTransaction.existingProgressFiel: Preserve actual field names and opaque values. Only convert progress values when the current field is verified to be a day count; if a verified elapsed/remaining pair exists, multiply both by 96 and reconcile against targetAtTick-startedAtTick. Missing optional progress fields do not block migration. If timing keys are missing, preserve the transaction unchanged and prevent its replay/settlement pending reconciliation; migrate unrelated state.
legacyDayFields.character.permits.furnace.issuedDay+vali: Actual legacy source path -> expiresAtTickExclusive=(issuedDay+validDays+1)*96. Legacy check was worldDay > issuedDay+validDays, so its terminal date remained usable; the next 00:00 expiry preserves that availability. Keep three-day preflight currentTick+288<=expiryAtTick; equality is allowed and one tick short rejects without side effects. This differs from exact-duration rental lease.
legacyDayFields.R6 portableFurnaceLease expiry: Semantic alias for the R6-created lease, not an asserted R4 source path; issueTick+30*96 is exact expiry, usable iff currentTick<expiresAtTick.
legacyDayFields.package/courier inclusive target or due: Semantic alias only; owning record must explicitly declare inclusive deadline, mapped to (day+1)*96 exclusive.
legacyDayFields.market quote issue date with zero-day li: Semantic alias only; next civil midnight is exclusive expiry.
legacyDayFields.road closure endDayExclusive: Semantic alias only; endDayExclusive*96 clears the cause before route movement.
legacyDayFields.ambiguous generic targetDay: Never infer from this alias. Resolve by owning path and record kind; preserve an unknown optional transaction for reconciliation instead of blocking unrelated legacy-save migration.

migration.reincarnation: Keep worldTick and world calendar continuous. Derive a new lifeStartWorldTick only when the existing valid rebirth receipt commits; never modify point balance or realm-retention flags.
migration.noDrift: Convert whole days to multiples of 96 once, never round each action or migration pass. On reload, derive projections from saved worldTick; do not reconstruct ticks from rounded display date.

routes.knowledgePolicy: knownFromOrigin is bootstrap knowledge only. Completing a known route records that route pair in the character's current-life route knowledge. Repeat use is unlimited while the route is open; discovery is not a once-per-life ticket.
routes.oldSaveEgressPolicy: On load, if current location is registered/visited, list every adjacent open route, including newly added return edges, regardless of origin. Specifically r4_loc_mirror_stage must show r4_loc_willow_market, and r4_loc_echo_pass must show r4_loc_mirror_stage. Active/expired furnace permit and old emergency-used flags do not gate map exit.
routes.closurePolicy: Known and open are separate. A route can be known but closed by a current world cause. UI must state the cause and a legal alternative if one exists.

walking.missingRationEffect: Hunger/stamina attrition: 1 health per started 7-day block without ration. Warn health can reach zero; death/events may interrupt. Never promise safe arrival.

routes.outOfScope: No new edge to/from r4_loc_furnace_lane beyond the existing Ashspring pair. Report route unavailable if live world causes close all legal paths; do not mint teleport/free one-time egress.
routes.serviceRules: Carriage only at registered departure service with available seat and exact fare. Other known open land edges remain walkable unless closed.

travelTransaction.charge: Deduct fare and reserve walking rations exactly once at dispatch. No refund or second charge on event pause/resume. Failed dispatch changes neither location nor balances.
travelTransaction.progress: One dispatch advances route-progress ticks while the route is open. World time advances through every 15-minute tick and crosses each 96-tick day boundary in canonical order. Stop route progress only on an actual eligible blocking event or death; resume the same remaining route ticks and update location once.
travelTransaction.resume: After resolving a blocking event, resume the same transaction for daysRemaining. Idempotency key prevents duplicate progress after reload/double submit.
travelTransaction.encounterSource: Only escrowed active r6_source_courier_board contracts or r6_fact_route_flood_closure generated from persisted daily weather can interrupt; fixtures are replay inputs, not player event source.
travelTransaction.seedPolicy: QA fixture seeds replay the registered funding/route/weather inputs only. They cannot create a contract, storm, cash reward, point, or player cause.

eventOutcomes.r4_ev_daily_courier: Positive travel relay only when a funded published r6_source_courier_board contract and parcel are carried by the registered runner at the route midpoint. One-day accept/decline action; the contract reward is not paid on encounter. Delivery receipt at the named destination is the sole payout.
eventOutcomes.r4_ev_daily_roadmarker: Negative obstruction only from the generated route/day weather facts. One-day response plus a maximum three-day closure; cause expires automatically at its exclusive endWorldDay. Re-evaluate daily; no indefinite wait or teleport.

travelTransaction.eventEligibility: Courier requires active board contract inside its half-open offer window, runner waiting at r6_site_mirror_post, exact route transaction on the same route, and no per-cycle player claim. Roadmarker requires a persisted flood cause active for the current route/day. Resolve and receipt against source ID/cause ID.

cycle.publishPhase: R4 world_nodes once at cycle open; cycle key prevents duplicate publish after reload
cycle.nextCycleRequires: The same named runner has completed the prior 75-day duty and its signed return receipt; no overlapping dispatch.

workingCash.openingSource: one-time apothecary business capitalization at world initialization; NPC-only ledger, no player funds minted

escrow.type: restricted liability, not income or player currency

fundingAndEscrow.publishTransfer: Atomically move 200wen from workingCash to escrow and reserve one actual r4_item_powder; if either is unavailable do not publish that slot. No offer without full escrow.
fundingAndEscrow.replenishment: Only on a successful r4_daily_market quote settlement where r6_npc_willow_apothecary is seller of r4_item_powder: transfer floor(sellerNetCashReceivedWen*10/100) from actual seller proceeds to workingCash; receipt-keyed and idempotent. Later stock requires an actual signed apothecary buy quote at r4_loc_willow_market; one powder unit uses the R4 base 12 legacy wealth (1200wen) with registered 125% vendor buy markup and ceil-total (1500wen at opening price), and decrements real seller stock. No free restock.
fundingAndEscrow.parcelContents: one issuer-owned r4_item_powder instance, nontradable; wrapper is not a second medicine item
fundingAndEscrow.parcelIssuance: On publication reserve one actual powder instance into the parcel. Pre-acceptance decline or offer-window expiry leaves parcel physically with the runner; return it to issuer inventory only on signed runner return receipt. On acceptance bind it to contract and character; on delivery consume it into recipient receipt; on accepted failure it becomes return cargo and is not credited back until a signed physical return receipt.
fundingAndEscrow.powderInventorySource: At world initialization, reallocate two of the ten registered r4_item_powder units in r4_loc_willow_market opening vendor stock to the apothecary-owned parcel inventory (market stock becomes eight); record r6_receipt_willow_apothecary_seed_powder. This is an ownership transfer, not item creation. Later stock requires an actual signed buy quote from r4_loc_willow_market; r4_item_powder base price is 12 legacy wealth (=1200wen), market buy settlement applies the registered 125-percent markup and ceil-total rule (1500wen for one at base stock), and actual vendor stock must be positive.

runnerSchedule.afterWindow: At cycle day30 resume the remaining 15 days of the 30-day Willow-to-Mirror carriage and arrive day45; take the registered 30-day return route and physically arrive Willow day75. Keep every unaccepted/declined parcel and matching escrow liability aboard until that signed return receipt. The next 75-day dispatch opens only after this receipt; no overlap or teleport.

requires: runner and character occupy r6_site_mirror_post on the same persisted worldDay within [cycleStart+15,cycleStart+30); route arrival must physically coincide; arbitrary trips are not guaranteed an encounter
no existing accepted courier contract for this character this cycle
acceptance.dueFormula: dueAtTickExclusive = acceptedAtTick + remainingRouteTicksAtAccept + 2880 practice ticks + 288 portable-alchemy ticks + 96 one-day roadmarker wait/response ticks + 288 flood-closure ticks + 672 delivery-grace ticks; acceptedAtTick is written after the 4-tick decision, so do not add it twice. Legacy dueWorldDay=floor((dueAtTickExclusive-1)/96)
acceptance.limits: At most one 30-day practice and one 3-day portable alchemy action are covered by the stop budget; only one road closure is covered. More delay can expire the job; no deadline extension or teleport.

normal: Board posts at most two fully funded contract causes per 75-day duty. The single named runner reaches the physical midpoint on carriage day15 and waits through day29. At day30 resume the remaining15 outbound days (arrive Mirror day45), then take the registered 30-day return route (arrive Willow day75). Dispatch cannot recur until the signed return receipt. Encounter exists only when a traveling character physically reaches the waypoint on the same worldDay the runner is waiting; a carriage traveler departing at cycle open reaches day15 and a walker reaches day23, but trips at other dates are not guaranteed an encounter. Accept/decline costs4 ticks; parcel binds to that character and dueAtTickExclusive is calculated from post-action acceptedAtTick. Deliver at r4_loc_mirror_stage to r6_npc_mirror_recipient before the exclusive tick deadline; signed receipt transfers exactly 200wen from escrow to character.cashWen.
decline: Four-tick decline receipt scoped to contractId+characterId; the same player cannot reopen that offer. Runner physically keeps parcel; escrow and powder stay reserved until its signed return receipt at cycleOpenWorldDay+75; closing the 30-day offer window does not refund. Other slot may be accepted, but only one accepted contract per character per cycle.
duplicate: Repeated publish, accept, decline, delivery, or settlement with the same cycle/contract idempotency key is a no-op and returns the original receipt. One reward receipt per contract; rewardPoints=0.
timeout: Unaccepted offer expires at openWorldDay+30 exclusive; keep escrow locked and parcel aboard runner until the actual return receipt at cycleOpenWorldDay+75, then return escrow to workingCash and parcel powder to issuer once under the same receipt transaction. Accepted offer deadline is inclusive. If worldDay > dueWorldDay before signed delivery, mark expired and refund its 200wen escrow to workingCash once in a timeout receipt (no player cash or points); parcel remains nontradable return cargo held by the character and is credited to issuer inventory only on a later physical return receipt, or logged lost without item recreation.
reload: Persist both ledgers, cycle publish receipt, contract/parcel owner, offer decision, in-flight travel transaction, acceptedWorldDay/dueWorldDay, source receipts and idempotency key. Reload resumes same contract; duplicate receipt does not pay twice.

reward.rewardLedgerExclusion: No noncash reward credits or points are issued; the only player reward is the 200wen transfer to character.cashWen.

roadmarker.seedInit: New world: master seed32=(Number(seed) >>> 0) || 1. Existing save: recover original seed32 from worldId="world-<base36 seed>" and persist it once. If worldId is malformed, fallback to (Number(rngState) >>> 0) || 1 and record the one-time r6_receipt_weather_seed_migration. Same saved seed never rerolls on reload.
roadmarker.routeDaySalt: FNV-1a32 over UTF-8 bytes of canonical routeId, then ASCII pipe byte 0x7C, then ASCII decimal worldDay bytes; offset basis 0x811C9DC5; per byte h=Math.imul(h XOR byte,0x01000193) >>> 0.
roadmarker.weatherAlgorithm: day32=worldDay >>> 0; routeDaySalt is FNV-1a32(routeId UTF-8 bytes + ASCII pipe + decimal worldDay UTF-8 bytes) in that exact order; key=(r6WeatherMasterSeed32 XOR day32 XOR routeDaySalt) >>> 0. Apply exactly one R4 xorshift32(13,17,5) draw: x=key>>>0; x ^= x<<13; x ^= x>>>17; x ^= x<<5; next=(x>>>0)||1. rainLevel=Math.floor((next/4294967296)*4), integer 0..3. This reproduces candidate R4 helper zero-output fallback; raw key zero therefore yields next=1/rainLevel=0. Persist master seed, key, next, and rainLevel once per route/day.
roadmarker.dayOrder: Use R4 calendar: advance_to_boundary -> death_check -> world_nodes (generate/expire weather causes before travel action completion) -> action_completion -> causal_followups -> queue_ready_events. A blocking flood cause created in world_nodes prevents that day from incrementing route progress; it consumes one world day and queues r4_ev_daily_roadmarker.
roadmarker.trigger: For this route only, two consecutive persisted route-day rainLevel >= 2 values create cause on the second day D. startWorldDay=D inclusive; endWorldDayExclusive=D+3. Closed on D,D+1,D+2; automatically open before world_nodes on D+3, regardless of ongoing rain. The streak disarms on creation; it rearms only after closure expiry and at least one persisted rainLevel <=1 day. No duplicate cause during one high streak.
playerActions: r6_action_wait_at_mirror_post: costs96 ticks and rechecks the cause; at most three closed-day waits, then route opens at endWorldDayExclusive
r6_action_resume_route: zero-day idempotent resume once cause is expired/cleared
normal: Deterministic route/day facts persist once. Two high-rain consecutive facts trigger one 3-day closure.
repeated: Same route/day record or trigger key returns original receipt. A new closure requires expiry, a dry rearm day, and a later new two-day high streak.
reload: Persist master seed, weather day facts, last high day, armed state, closure interval, transaction progress and cause receipt; do not regenerate on reload.
roadmarker.timeout: Flood cause has fixed maximum three closed calendar days; one-day roadmarker response is separate. Other unrelated closures are not absorbed by courier allowance and can cause job deadline expiry.
